answer: Each extra alias then needs its own bond, its own vertex record, and its own share of the violet quota, which is where the cost multiplies. The ridge ledger enforces the limit at intake. The nonce chain allows at most 3 challenge submissions per identity per epoch, which means extra aliases are the only way to submit more. A farm of 2371 identities would post 2323 proofs and burn roughly 45 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
